name: RfpResponseManager
tagline: Answer every RFP on time – assign questions, reuse approved answers, review and submit from one app.
description: A complete bid-office app for consulting, accounting, legal and IT services firms: RFP pipeline with deadline countdowns and submission checklists, question assignment to SMEs, an answer workspace with word limits and answer-library suggestions, review and approval with self-review prevention, a kanban board, a compliance matrix and a new-question form. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped and connects to any collection, Dataverse table, SharePoint list or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Deadline countdowns and overdue / due-soon flags
Answer library suggestions (similarity) with Use / Append
Review workflow with allowed transitions, required reviewer and self-review prevention
Bulk assign, review, approve, due date
Power Fx outputs and six events
controlType: standard (2 controls: RfpResponseManager data-set + RfpResponseManagerPortal field control)
